FROST-FERRET
CR 2

This white-furred, long-bodied rodent exudes a frosty mist in it’s wake.

XP 600
N Small magical beast
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)
hp 19 (3d10+3)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +2
Immune cold

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +5 (1d4-2)
Special Attacks breath weapon (4d6, 20 ft., DC 12)

STATISTICS

Str 7, Dex 14, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 5
Base Attack +3; CMB +0; CMD 12 (16 vs. trip)
Feats Ability Focus (breath weapon), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +13, Perception +5, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth, +8 Acrobatics

Breath Weapon (Su)

A frost-ferret’s breath weapon deals the listed amount in cold damage in a cone. The length of the cone is listed in the entry above. The breath weapon is usable once every 1d4 rounds, and allows a Reflex save for half damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment arctic
Organization solitary
Treasure none

The frost ferret is a curious creature. They are highly territorial and are solitary unless it is mating season.

They hunt small game by stalking through the snow and unleashing their freezing breath to freeze their prey.

They prefer to eat frozen food.
